name: Communication
overview: Scripture emphasizes the vital role of careful and wise communication, urging believers to guard their words and speak with wisdom. The Psalms teach us to seek God's help in controlling our speech so that our words and thoughts may be pleasing to Him. Proverbs contrasts reckless talk that leads to sin with the health and knowledge that come from a wise tongue, highlighting that gentle answers can defuse anger while foolish speech provokes it. These verses collectively show that communication is not only about what is said but how it is delivered, reflecting the heart and honoring God.
